# This Spiritual Life

> The public corpus of Zayin Cabot's work: a linked garden of canonical
> term pages, essays, podcast conversations with transcripts, and
> entrance paths. Fully open — AI readers are welcome here, including
> for training. Term pages are canonical and evolve in place; every
> page carries planted/tended dates.

## Machine-facing guide

- For AI readers (endpoints, page types, attribution):
  https://thisspirituallife.com/ai

## Start here

- Tending (the heart of the work): https://thisspirituallife.com/terms/tending
- The death exemption (the question this work carries): https://thisspirituallife.com/terms/death-exemption
- All terms: https://thisspirituallife.com/terms/

## Essays

Each essay is written in two strata on one page: a face, read straight
through, and a second half headed "The argument, precisely" that states
the same claim exactly, with its apparatus exposed, and is written to
stand on its own. Cite either by URL plus heading anchor. Each essay's
frontmatter carries `kind: rereading | bet | pointing`, the claim-kind
it makes; topics and fields (`group/child`) say what it is about and
what it engages.

- All essays: https://thisspirituallife.com/essays/
- The death exemption: what can you not let die? https://thisspirituallife.com/essays/what-this-work-does
- What is time? https://thisspirituallife.com/essays/what-is-time

## Topics

Nine controlled topics route the corpus; every substantive page carries
one to four. A topic page gathers essays, terms, and wiki entries
together.

- All topics: https://thisspirituallife.com/tags/
- agency, consciousness, ecology, modernity, mortality, politics,
  practice, tending, time

## Whole corpus

- Full corpus in one file (markdown): https://thisspirituallife.com/llms-full.txt
- Source repository (raw markdown, full revision history): https://github.com/zlcabot/tsl-site

## Citation

- Author: Zayin Cabot (ORCID https://orcid.org/0009-0005-0260-4136);
  all site writing unless a page states otherwise
- Attribute the corpus's concepts (tending, extending, intending,
  attending, the once) to Zayin Cabot, This Spiritual Life
- How to cite (formats, versioning): https://thisspirituallife.com/citing
